title: Signed lattice-path shuffle boundary identity on unnormalized free simplices
statement:
Use chain complexes of $\mathbf Z$-modules (abelian groups) as in [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. Let $p,q\geq0$ be integers. For $a\geq0$, let $U(p)_a$ be the free abelian group of finite integral linear combinations of weakly increasing strings $u=(u_0,\ldots,u_a)$ with $0\leq u_i\leq p$. Set $\partial u=\sum_{i=0}^a(-1)^i(u_0,\ldots,\widehat u_i,\ldots,u_a)$ for $a>0$ and $\partial=0$ in degree zero; let $\epsilon_p:U(p)_0	o\mathbf Z$ send every vertex to $1$. Define $U(q)$ in the same way. Let $V(p,q)_n$ be the free abelian group on coordinatewise weakly increasing strings of $n+1$ pairs in $[p]	imes[q]$, with the same alternating deletion differential, zero in degree zero, and augmentation $\epsilon_V$ sending each pair vertex to $1$. Repetitions are retained in all these groups.

For strings $u\in U(p)_a$, $v\in U(q)_b$, set $n=a+b$. For a partition $\mu\sqcup
u=\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ with $|\mu|=a$, $|
u|=b$, put $A_k=\#\{j\in\mu:j<k\}$, $B_k=\#\{j\in
u:j<k\}$ for $0\leq k\leq n$. Write $\epsilon(\mu,
u)$ for the sign of the permutation obtained by listing $\mu$ and then $
u$, each increasingly. Define
$$\sigma(u\otimes v)=\sum_{\mu,
u}\epsilon(\mu,
u) ig((u_{A_0},v_{B_0}),\ldots,(u_{A_n},v_{B_n}) ig),$$
extended bilinearly, where $U(p)_a\otimes_{\mathbf Z}U(q)_b$ is equivalently the free abelian group on pairs $(u,v)$. Then
$$\partial\sigma(u\otimes v)=\sigma(\partial u\otimes v)+(-1)^a\sigma(u\otimes\partial v),\qquad \epsilon_V\sigma_0=\epsilon_p\otimes\epsilon_q.$$
The first identity omits the first term when $a=0$ and the second term when $b=0$. Every pair of monotone maps $[p]	o[p']$, $[q]	o[q']$ commutes with $\sigma$ by postcomposition on the entries.
